findings.evidence: upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/SesquilinearForm/Basic.lean:771 `lemma apply_smul_sub_smul_sub_eq ... B ((B x y) • x - (B x x) • y) ((B x y) • x - (B x x) • y) = ...`, inside `namespace LinearMap` (line 44/304) → `namespace BilinForm` (line 769), i.e. the same `LinearMap.BilinForm` namespace this file opens at line 33.
findings.fix: Follow the adjacent upstream name: at minimum add the `_eq` suffix (`apply_smul_sub_self_eq`, `apply_sub_smul_self_eq`), or mirror `apply_smul_sub_smul_sub_eq`'s slot-by-slot spelling so the unscaled vector is visible in the name.
findings.issue: `apply_smul_sub_self` (and `apply_sub_smul_self`, line 46) declare into `LinearMap.BilinForm`, which already contains Mathlib's lemma for the same statement shape — the diagonal value of `B` at a scaled difference — under a different scheme: each slot spelled out, then `_eq`. The PR names describe one slot plus `self` and drop `_eq`, so `apply_smul_sub_self` does not distinguish `B (z • u - v) (z • u - v)` from the upstream `B (a • x - b • y) (a • x - b • y)`, and the two names sit side by side in one namespace with incompatible conventions.

findings.evidence: Radiative.lean:166-169, 159-162, 252-254. The adjacent convention in the same `Kinematics` namespace does mark the value: `Kinematics/Basic.lean:68 lemma q_eq_sub (K : DisKinematics V) : K.q = K.k - K.kPrime`, and the file's own `kPrime_eq_smul_leptonOut_of_collinear_finalState` (line 515) and `hadronicMethod_Q2_eq_trueInvariants_Q2` (line 214) spell their right-hand sides.
findings.issue: `leptonIn_sub_leptonOut` names only the left side of its equation; its content is the right side (`= pX - p`, the line-independence of the hadronic transfer), which the module docstring advertises as the reason the hadronic method is exact. Same defect at line 159 (`pX_sub_p : pX - p = k - kPrime - photon`) and line 252 (`p_add_leptonIn_initialState : p + leptonIn .initialState = pX + kPrime`): the name gives no indication of the asserted value, and a prefix is not enough to convey it here.

summary: Method and theorem names follow the roadmap's terminology and the earlier namespace/`_eq_Q2_div` findings are fixed, but the two new bilinear-form lemmas use a naming scheme inconsistent with the upstream lemma for the same statement shape in the very namespace they declare into, and three equation lemmas in Radiative.lean name only their left-hand side.
